outcome: Sleep patterns (actigraphy, Brief Infant Sleep Questionnaire, polysomnography)
Early neurodevelopment (Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development-III, Ages & Stages Questionnaire, Hammersmith Infant Neurological Examination)
cohort: The study included 28 preterm infants aged 28-34 weeks who were admitted to a single-center Level III neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: Sleep parameters and neurodevelopmental outcomes did not differ significantly between preterm infants who received caffeine therapy and those who did not, at 6 months of corrected age.
